subject.title: skill_workshop: quarantined proposals are CLI dead-ends (no apply/revise/reject path back)

question: Which recovery transition, if any, should Skill Workshop support for quarantined proposals?
rationale: Quarantine is the safety-held state for failed scans, so implementation quality cannot decide whether recovery should be reject-only, revise-to-pending after rescan, a restore action, or intentionally unsupported.

options.title: Add audited quarantine recovery
options.body: Support a bounded recovery path such as reject-from-quarantined plus revise-to-pending only after a fresh clean scan, with audit metadata and public docs.

options.title: Align with restore semantics
options.body: Wait for the rejected-restore direction to settle, then extend or adapt the same public restore model to quarantined proposals if maintainers want one recovery verb.

options.title: Keep quarantine terminal
options.body: Leave quarantined proposals immutable safety holds and document recreate-or-reject alternatives only if maintainers intentionally accept the UX cost.

recommendation.title: Add audited quarantine recovery
recommendation.body: Support a bounded recovery path such as reject-from-quarantined plus revise-to-pending only after a fresh clean scan, with audit metadata and public docs.
